inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.constructor.options
inputs.type: { registry?: ProjectRegistryService; outbox?: CommentOutboxService; cache?: ProjectionCacheService; remote?: RemoteProjectPort; auth?: NativeAuthService; arbiter?: RepositoryArbiterService; }
inputs.description: Optional collaborators for this session. A registry, outbox or arbiter that is left out gets a new default instance, a cache, remote or auth that is left out stays undefined, and every supplied value is stored as given when the session is constructed.

inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.assertProject.projectId
inputs.description: The project id the caller expects to be selected. When it is left out (undefined) no check runs, so the call succeeds even with no project open; when given, it must equal the selected project's id exactly, so any value throws while no project is open.

inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.open.directory
inputs.description: Any directory inside a Git work tree; the session uses that work tree's top-level directory, resolved with realpath, as the project root. A directory outside any work tree makes git fail, and the returned promise rejects with that error.

inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.snapshot.query
inputs.description: The revision to read: a null branch means the checked-out branch, and a null commit means that branch's tip. A non-null commit must be the branch tip or one of its ancestors and makes writable false, and a projectId, when given, must match the selected project.

inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.atBranch.branch
inputs.description: The branch name that must be checked out right now, compared exactly with the current branch's name. With a detached HEAD no branch is checked out, so the call throws for every name.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.assertProject
outputs.description: Always undefined: the method returns nothing, and a projectId that does not match the selected project is reported only by throwing.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.selecting
outputs.description: True only while an open() call is in progress and false again once that call settles, whether it succeeded or failed; it does not say whether a project is selected.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.open
outputs.description: The resolved snapshot of the opened project at the checked-out branch's tip, built the same way as snapshot(). If the snapshot step fails the promise rejects, but the project stays selected because open() sets the session fields before it reads the snapshot.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.requireProject
outputs.type: { root: string; source: GitSourceAdapter; planning: PlanningFacadeAdapter; catalog: CatalogService; }
outputs.description: The open project's root, source, planning and catalog in one new object. It is returned only when all four are set, and open() sets them before it reads the snapshot.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.mutable
outputs.type: Promise<{ revision: Revision; root: string; source: GitSourceAdapter; planning: PlanningFacadeAdapter; catalog: CatalogService; }>
outputs.description: The object requireProject returns plus the revision for the stored query, which the last open() or snapshot() call set. It is returned only when that query names no commit, its branch is the checked-out one, the revision is at that branch's tip, and the branch is not harness-evidence.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.atBranch
outputs.type: Promise<{ root: string; source: GitSourceAdapter; planning: PlanningFacadeAdapter; catalog: CatalogService; }>
outputs.description: The same value requireProject returns, returned only when the checked-out branch's name equals the branch given.

errors.name: ProjectNotSelectedError
errors.description: Thrown by assertProject when a projectId is given and differs from the selected project's id, and by snapshot through the query's projectId, with the message 'The requested project is not selected.'

errors.name: ProjectSwitchBlockedError
errors.description: Thrown by open while a run is busy or pending or another open() is still in progress, with the message 'Cancel or finish the current run before switching projects.'

errors.name: ProjectNotOpenError
errors.description: Thrown by requireProject when root, source, planning or catalog is unset, and by snapshot, mutable and atBranch through it, with the message 'Open a project first.'

errors.name: ProjectRevisionReadOnlyError
errors.description: Thrown by mutable when the stored query names a commit, its branch is not the checked-out one, its revision is not at the branch tip, or the branch is harness-evidence, with the message 'Historical views and other branches are read-only. View the checked-out branch tip to make changes.'

errors.name: CheckedOutBranchChangedError
errors.description: Thrown by atBranch when the checked-out branch's name differs from the branch given, which includes a detached HEAD, with the message 'The checked-out branch changed during this run.'

errors.name: Detached HEAD without a local branch
errors.description: Thrown by GitSourceAdapter.revision, and so by open, snapshot and mutable, when the requested branch is not a local branch or no branch is given and HEAD is detached, with the message 'Select a local branch. Detached HEAD is read-only and must have a named branch.'

errors.name: GitSourceAdapter.revision commit failure
errors.description: Thrown by GitSourceAdapter.revision, and so by snapshot and mutable, when a requested commit is neither the branch tip nor one of its ancestors, with the message 'This commit is outside the selected branch ancestry.'

errors.name: gitRevision failure
errors.description: Thrown by gitRevision, and so by snapshot, when a requested commit is longer than 300 characters or contains a NUL character, with the message 'Invalid revision.'

errors.name: Project session Git, registry, planning, or catalog failure
errors.description: Failures of the Git, project registry, planning and catalog calls made by open, snapshot, mutable and atBranch reach the caller unchanged, except a failed package.json read, which only means the project is not reported as a game.
